title: ASB Transcriptomics Skill Collection v2
description: Curated, evidence-grounded skill and software-tool collection for computational transcriptomics (bulk and single-cell RNA-seq analysis), generated by the AgenticScienceBuilder (ASB) pipeline from method papers and their public code repositories. Each skill names its source paper and, where a quote could be anchored, cites verbatim evidence from it or its repository README; skills are annotated with EDAM (Transcriptomics) and gated for licensing and personal data before release; the source paper of every skill is cited in its provenance block (provenance.source_papers) and must be cited alongside the collection. Released by the Holobiomics Lab (CNRS / Université Côte d'Azur). Source repositories: collection - https://github.com/HolobiomicsLab/asb-skills-transcriptomics; registry and tooling - https://github.com/HolobiomicsLab/asb-skill-collections; generating pipeline - AgenticScienceBuilder (repository to follow). Licence: collection content CC-BY-4.0; code Apache-2.0; verbatim quotes under quotation right (LICENSING.md).
